segments.text: What is the purpose of life?
For thousands of years, philosophers, poets and prophets have tried to answer it.
Some said happiness. Some said duty. Others said faith, or leaving something behind.
But maybe purpose isn't something you find, like a coin on the pavement.
Maybe it's something you make, a little at a time.
A kind word. A seed in the ground. A question asked out loud.
So, what is the purpose of life? Perhaps it's this: to make it mean something.
